name: Abendego's Squall (7-8)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
description: Abendego's Squall leaps from the water. Its mouth opens to snap against any part of the ship that it can reach.
disable: DC 23 Medicine (expert) to remove the harpoon, DC 23 Nature (trained), or DC 23 Intimidation (expert) to scare the orca away; two total successes are required to subdue the orca
reset: The Abendego's Squall returns to hunt down the Snapdragon after 8 hours.
routine:
d The Abendego's Squall Leaps over the Snapdragon with each action. When it lands, it deals 4] damage to the Snapdragon. All creatures on the deck take @Damage (3d10+40)[bludgeoning Damage and must attempt a DC 28 Reflex Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is Clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is Clumsy 2 until the end of its next turn.

Speed 30 feet

offensiveAbilities.name: Thar She Blows
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Abendego's Squall matches speed with the Snapdragon

Effect The orca leaps across the Snapdragon and tears its main mast from the deck in the process. This deals 30] damage to the Snapdragon. All creatures on deck take @Damage (3d12+4)[bludgeoning Damage damage from the shrapnel and must attempt a Basic DC 28 Reflex Saving Throw save. Abendego's Squall rolls initiative.
